claims.text: The data sources included varied text from conversational, literary, religious sources, news magazines, a book of proverbs, and a Human Rights declaration.
Text was aggregated from a variety of online public-domain sources and physical books scanned using OCR software.
Global Voices, a corpus of journalistic news text, was selected as a source for modern, colloquial text.
